thread:
nina: Publishing the RCA for the quantization-mismatch incident that caused inference errors for a subset of requests this morning. Internal doc: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.com/pm/1851001234 (internal only).
postmortem-bot: Postmortem uploaded. Timeline, impact, and root cause sections completed. Short executive summary autogenerated. :robot_face:
omar: TL;DR: A new 4-bit quantized model variant was promoted without verifying the kernel compatibility on the latest runtime; requests to that variant hit an untested codepath causing decode errors and 5xxs for ~14 minutes. No customer data exposure.
kate: Thanks for the upload. Can someone paste top-line actions so leadership can scan quickly?
nina: Copying immediate actions from the doc below. Please ACK and update ETA inside the doc.
```
- ACTION-Q1 | Owner: omar           | Revert promoted quantized variant and pin stable model versions | Due: 2026-03-31
- ACTION-Q2 | Owner: kate           | Add quantization-compat validity checks to model onboarding CI | Due: 2026-04-04
- ACTION-Q3 | Owner: observability  | Add metric & alert for decode-error-rate by model-variant + paging rule | Due: 2026-03-29
- ACTION-Q4 | Owner: cs             | Draft proactive customer note for affected tenants; coordinate with legal | Due: 2026-03-28
- ACTION-Q5 | Owner: nina           | Produce a short post-release verification runbook and attach to RCA | Due: 2026-04-02
- CHECKPOINT  | All owners          | Brief status update in the doc by EOD 2026-03-27
```
kate: Ill take onboarding CI changes. Plan: add a small runtime smoke test matrix (fp16/8/4) and a kernel sanity check. PR incoming within 48h.
observability: Will add the decode-error-rate metric to the serving dashboards and create an alert that pages the oncall team. Probe + test in staging today.
cs: Weve drafted a short, factual customer note. Sending to legal for clearance now. @legal please review.
legal: Reviewing the draft now. No legal exposure but recommend toning down technical detail in the customer-facing note.
omar: Revert applied for the promoted variant; rolling a pinned stable model to affected pools now. Will post rollout link: https://github.com/redwood/models/pull/888
nina: Scheduling a follow-up checkpoint meeting for owners: 2026-04-12 08:30 PT. Meeting link and agenda added to the doc. Please leave a short status in the doc if you can't make it.
postmortem-bot: Follow-up checkpoint added to calendar and reminder scheduled. :calendar:
kate: ACKed. Will update CI PR with test results once green.
observability: ACKed. Alert test passed in staging; will enable in prod after rollout completes.
cs: ACKed. Will publish customer note after legal signoff and attach to RCA.
nina: Thanks all. Treat the April 12 meeting as the closure checkpoint for this RCA. If you cannot attend, post a written update in the doc before the meeting. :white_check_mark:
